children: ByteDance has officially released the consumer version of its Doubao phone assistant, built on the Doubao app and developed with handset makers at the system level to explore AI use in smartphones through interaction, task execution, local memory, and search. According to ChainCatcher, the new version places greater emphasis on stability and everyday usability than the technical preview released at the end of last year.
The first consumer version will be available on the Nubia NaviX Ultra, which is now open for reservations and is scheduled to go on sale on September 16.

title: ByteDance's Doubao Phone Assistant Consumer Version Launches on Nubia NaviX Ultra
